description.narrative: Ireland’s Civil Society Partnership (ICSP) for A Better World is a new five-year funding scheme for key Irish international development NGOs. It integrates three concluding schemes, the Programme Grant II (long-term development, public engagement and development education), the Humanitarian Programme Plan (for protracted crises) and the Emergency Response Funds Scheme (pre-positioned funds for acute humanitarian response).
The ten ICSP partners are as follows: Concern, Trócaire, Self Help Africa, Christian Aid Ireland, Oxfam Ireland, Sightsavers Ireland, World Vision Ireland, Plan Ireland, ActionAid Ireland, and GOAL.
